The following references are character identity sheets and, if included last, the boxing gym spatial reference; never copy their multiview layout. Only show the characters actually requested in the Shot section. The specific Shot section overrides general cast, background and composition defaults.

Single vertical 9:16 anime frame for a mobile motion comic, one single continuous image, full-bleed, no panels, no borders.
Composition safe zone: keep faces and key action in the upper and central area; keep the bottom 20% and the right 15% free of key details (subtitles and UI overlay).

Two spaces in this scene; each shot states which one it uses.
Location: title-sequence black stage: a borderless pitch-black abstract stage with no floor, no walls and no furnishings, drawn as flat 2D anime artwork; one single soft key light from the upper-left; nothing else exists in the space.
Light: one single soft key light from the upper-left, no second light source; the black is flat painted black, not a photographic void.
Location (from 素材/场地 reference sheet): crossover boxing gym training floor: a bright airy square indoor boxing gym, floor matted wall to wall with seamed sky-blue mats with a red border strip, padded dark-maroon leather training dummy standing just behind centre court on the middle seam, a gear crate just right of centre court, a clear left/right axis splitting the floor into two halves, entrance door at the near-left edge, a hand-wrapping corner in the far-right corner, warm cream-white walls with a red and navy lower stripe, tall windows along the left wall flooding the room with daylight, a red-white-blue roped boxing ring at the far-left back, a row of red and black heavy bags along the far wall, white-painted roof truss with warm ceiling lamps
Light: bright daytime, daylight from the left windows and ceiling lamps, key light from the upper-left-front, soft fill from the back-right; bright and cheerful, never gloomy.

Characters (match the attached character sheets exactly; keep each character's own body proportions, nobody re-proportioned, nobody turned chibi):
Tatsumaki (One Punch Man): curly green hair, green eyes, dark green high-collar long dress with a modest side slit reaching only to the knee (no exposed thighs), black gloves, black boots, petite adult female build; her telekinesis shows as a glowing green outline and green ripples
Shinnosuke Nohara (Crayon Shin-chan): short black hair with 5 spiky tufts, thick black caterpillar eyebrows, small black dot eyes, red T-shirt, yellow shorts, chubby 5-year-old toddler proportions
Saitama (One Punch Man): completely bald head, minimal black dot eyes, blank deadpan expression, plain yellow jumpsuit with black belt, white cape, red gloves, red boots, plain adult male build

Style: High-quality polished modern 2D anime key-visual illustration, hand-drawn 2D cel-animation artwork, similar to official TV anime key visual art. Clean precise medium-weight black line art, clearly visible on every edge including hair, clothing, props and background, never softened away, never blurred, never replaced by airbrushed gradients. Hard-edged flat two-tone cel shading on skin and hair with crisp shadow boundaries, no airbrushed gradients on faces, no soft blur on skin. Fully illustrated 2D painted backgrounds with believable depth and perspective, built from flat color planes and crisp hand-drawn linework, with only minimal hard-edged two-tone cel shading and no soft gradients on walls, floors or furnishings. Natural believable color palette, not oversaturated, not flat. Refined facial rendering with subtle eye highlights, clean line art and nuanced expressions. Professional anime-production-level polish and consistency across every panel. Hand-drawn 2D illustration only, painted cel look, 2D animation artwork.

No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no captions, no watermark, no signature. High detail.
Negative: no text, no letters, no captions, no subtitles, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no signature, no panel borders, no comic panel layout, no split screen, no character redesign, no outfit change, no hairstyle change, no extra or missing limbs, no deformed hands, no duplicated characters, no dark gloomy lighting, no warehouse look, no photorealistic or live-action rendering, no 3D render, no oversaturated colors, no CGI, no computer-generated look, no videogame cutscene look, no clay or plastic render, no ray-traced lighting, no global illumination, no ambient occlusion, no volumetric light shafts, no lens flare, no depth of field, no bokeh, no photographic blur, no specular PBR highlights, no metallic PBR shading, no subsurface scattering, no soft airbrush rendering on skin, no airbrushed gradient replacing line art, no missing or faded outlines, no 3D-looking background, no photoreal materials

[06] Shot: extreme close-up, front view. On the pitch-black stage, two dramatic silhouettes: on the left a hand completely wrapped in white bandages clenched into a fist, on the right a row of sharp white bone spikes bursting out of a forearm; thin cold rim light on their edges. No faces, no characters' identities visible.
This shot uses a pure black background, overriding the general gym location.
